notes: 12 endpoints across 10 route files (matching system-design §2.6 and the PRD API table, FR-34), plus 2 existing endpoints extended without contract change: /api/internal/email/dispatch (publishDueAnnouncements, FR-27) and /api/files/:id (the 'announcement' context, FR-30).
Base path is /api, not /api/v1. Envelopes, pagination (default 20, max 100; manage max 50) and error codes come from src/server/http.ts. RATE_LIMITED 429 already exists in ApiErrorCode.

Error policy: targeting violations → 403 (AC-3). Non-member, not-visible or non-owner access to a specific announcement → 404. State conflicts (author editing ARCHIVED, ack without requiresAck, remind when !requiresAck) → 409. Second reminder within 24h → 429 with details.retryAfter (FR-25, ADR-4).

Contract decisions beyond system-design: zero-recipient publish returns VALIDATION_ERROR with details.reason='NO_RECIPIENTS'. PATCH mode=draft on a PUBLISHED row is 409 (archive instead). Archive is idempotent. Ack also sets readAt if it was empty. Remind with nobody left still claims the throttle and returns notified: 0. On feed page 1, pinned items are lifted to the top and meta.total excludes them. Manage accepts an optional ?status filter on displayStatus. Percentages are integers rounded half-up, or null when the denominator is 0.
Schema addition: Announcement.lastRemindedAt DateTime? (FR-25), already listed in system-design §1.
NotifyInput gains an optional mandatoryInApp override (system-design A9) so announcement.published stays a single type key (FR-26).
Shared DTOs (AudienceRow, AnnouncementInput, FeedItem, AnnouncementDetail, AudienceCounts) are in api-contracts.json `components`. src/lib/validators/announcements.ts should mirror them.
